purpose: Approximate final-product concepts for implementation planning

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: concept illustration embedded in a desktop Pomodoro Timer implementation plan.
Create a high-fidelity, crisp product UI design board, landscape 1536x1024 composition, straight-on flat application mockups, no perspective, no laptop/phone hardware, no browser address bar. This is a Windows/macOS/Linux desktop application with shared app content and neutral native window chrome.
Use the existing app's blue/navy visual identity: deep navy surfaces, warm white text, restrained blue primary actions, muted neutral secondary text. Clean typography, generous space, subtle borders, readable contrast, realistic software screenshot appearance.
Two panels on a neutral dark presentation background with small labels above, left large main app window labelled "Focus timer", right a much smaller horizontal pinned timer labelled "Compact mode". Keep all windows fully visible and sharp.
Main window title "Pomodoro Timer", a narrow sidebar with Timer selected, Tasks, Reports, Settings. Main content has a Pomodoro / Stopwatch segmented control with Pomodoro selected; small phase tabs Focus, Short break, Long break with Focus selected. A thin circular blue progress ring surrounds large monospaced time "18:42", below it "Focus · Round 2 of 4". Selected task card below "Write project proposal" with smaller "Work". Controls "Pause" in blue, "Finish early" secondary. Footer three small summary items "Today 2h 25m", "4 completed", "Goal 3h". Small "Saved on this device" status.
Compact window has only a tiny blue progress arc, large "18:42", task text "Write project proposal", clearly visible pause icon, pin icon, and expand icon. Enough width for accessible separate controls, approximately 340x110 logical pixels, not a huge duplicate of main app.
Typography must be coherent, legible, correctly spelled with no dense tiny text. Purpose is a believable approximate final product, not marketing graphics. No slogans, no invented brand logo, no gradient neon, no decorative 3D or people. Never display framework names, code, or infrastructure details in UI.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: concept illustration embedded in a desktop Pomodoro Timer implementation plan.
Create a high-fidelity, crisp product UI design board, landscape 1536x1024 composition, straight-on flat desktop app mockups, no perspective, no laptop/phone hardware, no browser chrome.
Show two fully visible equally weighted application windows side by side on a pale neutral presentation background: left label "Tasks", right label "Reports". They belong to the same Windows/macOS/Linux desktop app named "Pomodoro Timer". Use shared clean modern visual language, readable system sans-serif typography, off-white backgrounds, restrained blue primary actions derived from the current app blue/navy palette, navy text, subtle neutral borders. Left sidebar in each window has Timer, Tasks, Reports, Settings; Tasks selected on left, Reports selected on right.
Tasks window: title "Tasks"; "+ New task" action. Project filters "All", "Work", "Personal", Work selected. Three tidy rows with open checkboxes: "Write project proposal", "Review design draft", "Read research notes". First row selected with small "Focused task" label and a blue "Start focus" button in its details area. Details include text "Estimate 3 sessions", "Focused today 50m", "Add a note". One completed row "Plan the week" with a checked checkbox and subdued text. Avoid a complicated kanban board or extra features.
Reports window: title "Reports"; segmented period choices "Today", "Week", "Month", Week selected; top-right "Export". Three summary cards "Focus time 12h 45m", "Completed 24", "Interrupted 3". Crisp readable simple bar chart labelled "Focus time" with seven weekday bars Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun. Bottom section "By project" with two clearly labelled horizontal bars Work and Personal. Footer "Pomodoro + Stopwatch", small explanatory "Completed and interrupted sessions tracked separately". Charts should resemble actual usable application charts, not scientific results.
Keep generous whitespace, crisp balanced geometry, reasonable sizes and text. Do not add accounts, subscriptions, AI chat, cloud provider setup, avatars or business dashboards. No watermark or slogan. Never display framework names, database terms, code, or infrastructure details in UI.
